تقلعفوا (form IVq)
# تَقْلَعِفُّوا (taqlaʕiffū) /taq.la.ʕif.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# تُقْلَعَفُّوا (tuqlaʕaffū) /tuq.la.ʕaf.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
